name: Changed by others
title: Changed by others: your pages somebody else changed since you last opened them, in the morning brief, with what the changes did

events.opened: You pressed Open the page on a page the morning brief said somebody else changed
events.seen: You pressed Seen on a page the morning brief said somebody else changed

runs.shown: Rouh put pages somebody else changed in the morning brief

permissions: reads the changes made to your organisation's pages by other people (Ask AI's changes and typed changes) over the last week, and when you last opened each page
touches.remove: Turn the switch others_changed off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone; to remove it for good revert night 21's commit (rouh/others_changed.py, the brief_others_changed route and its lines in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawOthersChanged and its helpers in briefpage.js and the .bf-others rules in briefpage.css, this manifest) and delete the user setting others_changed.
